subject: general
question:
Consider the following statements about magnetic field of a Bar Magnet

(a) It has magnitudes and directions both.

(b) Magnetic field lines are closed curves.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both (a) and (b).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Statement (a) is **correct **as the magnetic field of a bar magnet has both **magnitude and direction.**
 
• Statement (b) is also **correct **as magnetic field lines are **closed curves** that emerge from the **North pole **and terminate at the **South pole** of a magnet.
 
• The area in which the** force of magnetism** acts around a magnetic material or a moving **electric charge** is known as the **magnetic field. **
 
• The** strength and direction **of the magnetic field are shown by **imaginary lines** known as** magnetic field lines.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **rectangular portion **of an object with persistent magnetic qualities that can be made of** iron, steel,** or any other** ferromagnetic material or ferromagnetic composite** is called a **bar magnet. **
 
• It has two poles: a** north and a south pole.**
 
• When the magnet is **suspended freely, **its two poles align such that the **northern pole** faces the **earth's magnetic north pole.**
 
• At the **poles,** its **magnetic pull **is at its **strongest.**
 
• The** unlike poles **of two bar magnets **will attract **one another while the** like poles will repel **one another when they are positioned close to one another.
